title: Business Central 2026 release wave 2 (BC29): Design document reports with the updated Word add-in (New design components)
summary: Business Central 2026 wave 2 introduces new design components in the Word add-in for document reporting, allowing developers to create report layouts faster by inserting pre-built elements like addresses, field groups, amounts, signature lines, and notes with single clicks instead of manually building complex layouts.
key_points: Microsoft added design controls for common document report parts including addresses, field groups, amounts, signature lines, and notes
Design components can be inserted with single clicks, dramatically faster than building layouts manually or with RDLC
Word add-in version 3.0.0.0 is the latest version and should be installed from the Add-ins menu
Pre-built components arrive with example figures and layouts that developers can customize by replacing with actual data fields
New components include options like sender/receiver addresses, document information grids, calculation tables, and totals rows

quotes.text: This dramatically speeds up layout creation for developers.
quotes.why_it_matters: Emphasizes the time-saving benefit of using pre-built design components in the updated Word add-in
